question: who has the biggest job here by invoice value
reason: The oracle passes (its case has no internal-word clause), but the card shows 'Referenced records: Invoice #143' next to '18602'. Record 143 is the ZRA invoice of 201,250,000 TZS (E3914 in the E5 answers). The row carries invoice.items_total but no invoice.invoice_number, so the label fell back to the database id (record_links.py:191-194). Wave I's plan had no invoice columns and referenced only the job ('18602'). Second instance of the LT1-t4 defect.
